summary: Iteration 6 validates the gallery taxonomy restructure into 3 top-level categories (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, RESTORATION & RENOVATIONS). All backend taxonomy, migration and ingest tests pass (5/5). All frontend tab/folder-card/admin-dropdown checks pass. Regression checks (portfolio, hero-covers, videos tabs; footer email/socials; share-as-pin lightbox) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~690 lines and growing — consider splitting routers (gallery, admin, auth, uploads) into modules once it crosses 700 lines.
SUBCATEGORY_ALIASES migration is one-shot at boot; if new legacy variants ever slip in via API they won't be normalized. Consider a POST-side normalizer.
GalleryPage.jsx's closeFolder uses stale useSearchParams snapshot pattern — works but could be simplified to setParams(prev => { const q = new URLSearchParams(prev); q.delete('folder'); return q; }).
AdminGallery form title/description use uncontrolled dispatch of native events; automation-friendly but React onChange handlers may miss programmatic value sets — a minor DX note, not a bug.
test_credentials: No credentials required — /admin uses passless-login auto sign-in.
seed_data_creation: One RESTORATION photo created via POST /api/admin/gallery for ingest validation, then cleaned up. One extra restoration photo created via UI E2E flow also cleaned up (id f7251965-... deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/gallery/taxonomy returns the new 3-category structure. Legacy sub aliases (Kitchen, Balcony & Dry area, Offices, Retail, Office Spaces, Temple, Balcony - Dry Area) are all migrated at boot. Old test file /app/backend/tests/test_caremanto.py still contains OUTDATED taxonomy expectations from prior iterations — do not run it as-is or update fixtures first (previous testers already flagged). /gallery default tab = RESIDENTIAL, 5 folder cards; COMMERCIAL = 3; RESTORATION shows empty-state 'coming soon' when no photos, else photo grid — no folder cards. Admin category dropdown = ['', RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, RESTORATION & RENOVATIONS]. Selecting RESTORATION disables the sub select (shows '—') and disables is_cover checkbox. Portfolio + Hero-Covers filter dropdowns include RESTORATION & RENOVATIONS. Footer email care@caremanto.in and 4 social links present.
